nodes.name: Pretreatment of Nickel Foam
nodes.procedure: The nickel foam (1cm × 2cm) was pretreated before preparing the NiFe-LDH/NF electrode. The nickel foam was sequentially immersed in 2 M HCl, deionized water, acetone, and again in deionized water, each for 20 min, to remove oil and oxides from the surface. The cleaned nickel foam was then dried in a vacuum oven for 1 h.

unit_operations.procedure_snippet: dried in a vacuum oven for 1 h.

nodes.source_text: firstly, the nickel foam (1cm × 2cm) was pretreated before preparing the NiFe-LDH/NF electrode. ... The cleaned nickel foam was then dried in a vacuum oven for 1 h.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: The NiFe-LDH catalyst was prepared using the electrodeposition method in a three-electrode system, with pre-treated nickel foam, a saturated calomel electrode, and a platinum sheet as the working electrode, reference electrode, and counter electrode, respectively. The electrolyte was composed of 0.1 M FeSO4·7H2O and 0.1 M NiSO4·6H2O. The deposition voltage is -0.8 V (vs. SCE), and the deposition time is 600 s. The prepared nickel-iron layered double hydroxides were rinsed three times with deionized water and ethanol, and then dried in air for 6 h.

unit_operations.name: Electrodeposition
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: deposition voltage of the first stage is -0.8 V (vs. SCE), and the deposition time is 600 s.

unit_operations.name: Rinsing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: rinsed three times with deionized water and ethanol

nodes.source_text: Then, the NiFe-LDH catalyst was prepared using the electrodeposition method ... dried in air for 6 h, labeled NiFe-LDH/NF.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of CoMo-P on NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: The NiFe-LDH/NF catalytic electrode prepared above was used as the working electrode. The composition of the electrolyte in the second stage was: 0.1 M Co(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.05 M NaMoO4·2H2O, 0.5 M NaH2PO2·H2O and 1 M NH4Cl. The deposition voltage is -1.2 V and the deposition time is 200 s. The prepared catalytic electrode was rinsed three times with C2H5OH (ethanol) and deionized water, respectively. Then, it was dried in a drying oven at 60°C for 6 h.

nodes.name: Preparation of Pt/C on nickel foam
nodes.procedure: The Pt/C powder (20 mg, 20 wt%) was dissolved in a mixture of Nafion (50 μL, 5%), deionized water (0.5 mL), and C2H5OH (0.5 mL) subsequently, the mixture was then ultrasonic for 30 min to disperse evenly. Then the mixture solution was evenly coated on both sides of the nickel foam, and then it was dried in a vacuum oven at 60°C for 6 h.
